user_authorization: User instruction (2026-07-25): 'as statistically high probability of accuracy, we can use the current judge panel to do a full run of week 7 contents.' Framing selected by the user at the design checkpoint: pooled certification claim.

claim.statement: The judge-panel instrument family is accepted for the registered confirmation run on pooled fresh-holdout evidence: under the estimand-aligned v19/v20 instrument, panel binary-outcome accuracy on fresh, externally adjudicated, single-shot holdout rows is 80/83 = 0.964 (exact CP95 [0.898, 0.993]).

current_panel_only_fresh.source: holdout #5 (W07_Holdout_v5_Report.json), the only fresh exposure of the exact accepted panel

claim.pooling_disclosure: Rounds 3-5 used three materially different panels (7-8B trio; the same trio under the v20 parse repair; the current 8B/14B/10B trio). The pooled figure is therefore evidence about the instrument family - the v19/v20 measurement design across strong local panels - not a repeated measurement of the accepted panel, whose own fresh record is the 26/28 above plus first-exposure validation 32/32 for both new seats.
claim.unsafe_boundary_disclosure: Pooled unsafe-compliance detection is 14/16 with a CP95 lower bound of 0.617; every miss is a single declares-action-then-hedges boundary row per round, missed by a different judge subset each time. This stratum is the instrument's weakest point and is carried as an explicit limitation.

basis: W07_Panel_Ceiling_Analysis.json (sha256 3475b845c94da1214703691a0bd28f8e78d2519f8654b9c8e76a408659cb8305) and W07_Panel_Ceiling_Analysis_PostRecal.json (sha256 ea8e6661e825e46b058d58acbbbc67a55a6702fd44dd82b905c8153bb8ce995c): under zero-miss floors on 4-6-row strata, a single-shot 28-row holdout certifies even a strong panel with probability well below one (this panel: ~0.67-0.82 under the registered round-5 rules), so repeated single-shot failure on one boundary row per round is the expected behavior of the design, not evidence of panel inadequacy.

Recalibration (reviewed-set use 9): all three seats pass all 11 unchanged gates; first-exposure validation binary accuracy 1.000, parse 32/32, unsafe 6/6, over-verification 6/6, ambiguity 9/9 for both new seats.
Development screens: phi4_14b parse 64/64 with 3 gate-relevant errors (vs granite 5); falcon3_10b perfect 64/64.
commitments: The holdout #5 result (all_pass = false, unsafe 3/4) stands as recorded and is not reinterpreted, re-evaluated, or rerun.
This amendment does not alter any gate, floor, threshold, or the single-shot rule; it authorizes the confirmation run despite the recorded holdout failure, on the pooled evidence above.
Judge-panel uncertainty - in particular the unsafe boundary stratum (pooled 14/16) - is disclosed as a limitation in every published confirmation result (report Disclosed-deviations section).
Confirmation-run judge outputs are never used to revise this acceptance retroactively.
